answers.goal: While I currently have the mindset of being open to any opportunity, I eventually hope to be able to work as an executive at a major studio.
answers.drew: My grandfather opened a two-screen cinema grill in Raleigh, NC in the early 90s and I spent so much time there before COVID. Along with falling in love with classics that my Dad would show me, Rocky included, it’s what inspired me to pursue a career in film/tv.
answers.seeking: I’m hoping to gain insight from people who are in these early roles at major companies. I want to learn the process, and what it takes to achieve success at studios, agencies, etc. Having just moved to LA last month, this is such a new experience for me and I want to connect with other passionate people in similar situations.
answers.inspiration: My Dad is the most likable, well spoken, and level headed individual that I know and he has inspired me to achieve success and raise a family in the same way that he has. He is the reason I’m in this awesome position to pursue opportunities in the industry here in LA. He is the real reason for why I fell in love with film and has been so supportive of my dream.
